newsitem.title: LIECHTENSTEIN: LGT says committed to new investments.
newsitem.headline: LGT says committed to new investments.

text.p: Liechtenstein Global Trust (LGT) said that it would continue to develop its offering of non-traditional investments.

"Liechtenstein Global Trust intends to develop non-traditional products systematically in the future, starting with Castle Private Equity Ltd," the financial group said in its annual report for 1996 released on Thursday.
The group's Castle Alternative Invest AG, listed on the Swiss stock exchange in April, invests in over 20 different hedge funds.
The non-traditional assets investment sector includes hedge funds, venture capital, private equity and commodity trading activities.
LGT noted that the sector was showing strong growth as institutional and private investors seek to diversify their holdings. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
